OtherNames: Khalifa Port AD Ports-Nimex LNG terminal
ResearcherNotesProject: UAE's first private-sector LNG terminal. AD Ports Group and Nimex Terminals signed two long-term agreements on 2025-11-04 (deal valued at >AED 30bn / ~USD 8.2bn over a projected 50-year revenue stream; AD Ports committed up to AED 1.3bn for marine/infrastructure, Nimex up to AED 2.6bn for terminal construction). Facility spans 130,000 m2 with cryogenic storage of 400,000 m3; designed to handle large long-haul gas carriers as an import/export/transshipment hub primarily serving Asian markets. Initial operations targeted mid-2028, steady-state by 2031. No MTPA throughput figure reported by either source, so Capacity left blank (storage volume 400,000 m3 noted here per SOP). AD Ports Group is the infrastructure landlord/JV partner; Nimex Terminals is the terminal developer/operator (treat AD Ports as Parent/partner). Corroborated by AD Ports official PR + AGBI. Distinct from all six existing GEM UAE terminals (Das Island, Fujairah, Jebel Ali FLNG, Ruwais FSRU, Ruwais LNG export, Sharjah FSRU).
